hero.title: Bách Mã Viên
hero.lead: A Wild West-style horse riding ranch in Hoa Bac, Da Nang.

story.text: Have you ever dreamed of putting on a cowboy hat and riding a horse across open grassland? At Bach Ma Vien, that dream is only a short drive from Da Nang city centre. Nestled in the green valleys of Hoa Bac (now part of the new Hai Van Ward), our farm brings the Wild West to Central Vietnam: friendly horses, rustic wooden fences, baskets of fresh grass to feed the horses, archery challenges and cowboy-style photo spots. Whether it is your first time near a horse or you are ready to become a real cowboy, our well-trained team will guide you every step of the way.
story.closing: Wild West, Real Feel. Come and live the moment at Bach Ma Vien.
